title: simply-blur-detector
subtitle: CNN meets Laplacian, in your browser
description: Drop in a picture and compare a small Keras CNN with Laplacian variance, including a window-by-window blur heat map. No upload needed.
longDescription: A TensorFlow / Keras CNN trained on sharp illustrations and copies blurred with blur-generator. The 2026 version includes original training artwork, x86 and ARM Docker support, and ONNX export for a browser demo that compares the CNN with Laplacian variance. Its verdict is a model estimate, with both methods visible for comparison.
features: Browser-local inference and patch-by-patch heat maps
CNN and Laplacian variance side by side
Original sharp and blurred training illustrations
challenges: Matching preprocessing between Python training and browser inference
solutions: The same equalisation, resize and normalisation steps across training and export
results: Interactive GitHub Pages demo with local image processing
Reproducible training assets and model evaluation in the repository
